panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — At the established taped-off microwave, Jax keeps hold of his covered soup while Zib sets a multimeter and temperature probe on a cloth. Kreeb carries the last surplus chair out of the way at the edge of the frame; Noola remains at the window, outside this shot.
PANEL 2 — Close at the personal cubby: Glorp folds a stained cleanup cloth into the overflowing bin. Kreeb's newly stacked clean trays occupy the space where Glorp keeps his chipped blue-striped mug.
PANEL 3 — Two-shot of Glorp silently removing the misplaced trays from his cubby and placing them on Kreeb's cleared table. Kreeb stops; their eyes meet over the inconvenient stack.
PANEL 4 — Jax approaches the taped-off microwave, notices warmth from its right side without touching the panel, and withdraws his hand. Zib turns to the temperature probe.
PANEL 5 — Practical insert: the probe registers a hotter right-hand side beside the still-taped microwave door. No extra characters or displays are necessary.

PANEL 6 — Astra offers to carry the displaced trays but sets one on Glorp's personal coaster as she turns. Glorp quietly lifts it away. At the far edge of the counter, only Zib's hands and probe show that the vent check is continuing.
PANEL 1 — At the small break-room table, Jax tries to sit with his still-cold soup. Kreeb draws an extra chair up opposite him and mistakes proximity for hospitality. Frame just the pair and bowl.
PANEL 2 — Brick leans into Jax's view beside the extra chair to scrutinize his covered soup. Jax pulls it protectively closer; Kreeb's hospitality has already been established in the preceding panel.

PANEL 3 — Glorp takes hold of the extra chair to move it off his cleaned floor. Kreeb grabs the other side. Keep the absurd tug-of-war tight on Glorp and Kreeb; Jax's soup bowl and his trapped seated position remain legible in the foreground.
PANEL 4 — Noola leaves her window nook with a drink, sidestepping Zib's tool case on the way to the doorway. This is her solitary exit, not a group reaction.
PANEL 5 — Beside the microwave, Zib finds a laminated strip covering the vent and begins to peel it away. Glorp catches the opposite end, protective of the sign. The blocked vent is the visual point.

PANEL 6 — Foreground: Jax alone with his cold soup and two displaced chairs. Farther back, Zib holds the peeled strip beside the still-warm panel; Kreeb's hand finally releases the chair. Keep Jax's exasperation visually dominant, without a six-person lineup.
PANEL 1 — Small ordinary insert on the microwave timer reaching zero after Jax's normal heating cycle; chairs are still slightly out of place but the appliance works.
PANEL 2 — Jax removes the warm soup bowl from the microwave. Noola glances up from her own window-facing seat. The two are spatially separated; Glorp and Kreeb's table conversation remains off-frame.
PANEL 3 — Tight on Jax taking a satisfied first warm spoonful. Nobody applauds. Astra walks past with the emptied cleanup bin in the background.
PANEL 4 — The narrow under-counter paper-printer slot suddenly whirs; a fresh slip starts to emerge. The microwave remains quiet and operational.
PANEL 5 — Reaction two-shot: Glorp brightens at the remembered printer sound. Kreeb catches the expression and nearly smiles. Do not widen this moment into an ensemble reaction.

PANEL 6 — Jax freezes with warm soup spoon raised, staring at the emerging slip. In the foreground Glorp's hand is already reaching for the paper; Astra notices a beat too late at the edge of the frame. Their eye lines converge on the printer.

PANEL 1 — Return to the functional bright break room, showing the restored microwave, clear vent, and recognizable counter and window geography. Jax eats at the small table, Noola occupies her window-facing chair, and Glorp's chipped blue-striped mug is back on its personal coaster. This is an establishing view of the space, not a posed all-hands group.
PANEL 2 — At adjacent but separate seats, Noola eyes Jax's steaming soup while Jax keeps eating. Both retain their own territory.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb pauses several feet from Noola with the bright chair rather than relocating hers. He gestures toward an empty table; Noola directs him there without abandoning her window.
PANEL 4 — At the counter, Glorp slides a communal tray clear of his mug. Kreeb notices and deliberately does not reorganize either object.
PANEL 5 — Pixa puts the kettle and charging lead back in their usual places. Brick sits in the too-bright corner as Pixa passes him a normal drink. Keep the focus on the two of them.

PANEL 6 — Intimate two-shot: Glorp and Kreeb exchange a brief suspiciously peaceful glance across the table. Jax's salt request comes from off-panel and breaks the moment. End on the interrupted truce, not a crowded group portrait.
